captions.text: Should a phone need / its owner's ID / to [work]?
captions.plain: Should a phone need its owner's ID to work?

captions.text: Mexico now ties every phone / line to its owner's ID, / against [extortion and fraud].
captions.plain: Mexico now ties every phone line to its owner's ID, against extortion and fraud.

captions.text: Unlinked lines are cut off / by last digit. Ending in 3: / [2.2 million] lines.
captions.plain: Unlinked lines are cut off by last digit. Ending in 3: 2.2 million lines.

captions.text: Calls, texts, data: off. / The number is kept until / the line is [linked].
captions.plain: Calls, texts, data: off. The number is kept until the line is linked.

captions.text: No ID, no phone. / The earthquake alert / still [gets through].
captions.plain: No ID, no phone. The earthquake alert still gets through.
